sections.title: Listening. Listen to a radio programme about a young athlete. Choose the correct answers.
sections.script:
Presenter: Nigora is sixteen and she's the national junior champion in rock climbing. Nigora, how did you start?
Nigora: My uncle took me to a climbing wall when I was ten. I was terrified at first, but by the end of the day I didn't want to go home!
Presenter: How often do you train?
Nigora: Five days a week, after school. At weekends I go to real mountains near Chimgan, if the weather is good enough.
Presenter: Have you ever been injured?
Nigora: Yes, last year I sprained my wrist and couldn't climb for two months. That was really frustrating.
Presenter: What are your plans?
Nigora: Next spring I'm going to compete in Kazakhstan. And in the future I'd like to become a climbing instructor, so I can teach other girls.

items.q: How did Nigora feel the first time she climbed?
When does she climb real mountains?
o: At weekends, if the weather is good

sections.title: G. Read the text. Choose the sentence (A–G) that fits each gap. There are two extra sentences.
sections.passage:
When Shahzoda was fifteen, she decided to cycle from Tashkent to Samarkand — about 300 kilometres. (1) ___ Her parents were worried, but her uncle, a professional cyclist, agreed to go with her.

They trained for three months. Every weekend they rode longer distances in the hills. (2) ___ By the end of the summer, she could cycle 100 km in a day.

On the first day of the trip, a strong wind blew against them for hours. (3) ___ On the second day, Shahzoda’s back wheel broke in a small village. Luckily, a mechanic there repaired it for free.

On the third evening they finally saw the blue domes of the Registan. (4) ___ ‘I was exhausted, but I was so proud of myself,’ she says.

Today Shahzoda is studying sports science at university. (5) ___

A  At first, she was so tired that she wanted to give up.
B  She had never cycled more than 20 kilometres before.
C  It was the most beautiful sight of her life.
D  She also wants to organise a cycling club for girls.
E  They travelled by train to save time.
F  They only covered 60 km instead of 100.
G  Her uncle bought her a new car.
